topic: Low sensor packet rates at Danish facility
summary_markdown:
A participant reported low packet counts from an AFA sensor located in Denmark (Slotsgade, 3639). The average count was noted as 580 packets per hour against a normal rate of 720. Another similar issue was mentioned regarding an AFA sensor at Nørre Voldgade 88 (3504), which had previously been low but returned to normal levels the previous evening.

Discussion points included whether existing monitoring systems for such issues were being utilized, with one participant suggesting that the current system needed tuning to function correctly.
decisions: The AFA sensor at Slotsgade (3639) needs to be rebooted.
action_items: Review and tune the existing monitoring system for sensor issues.
